name: How long does the pool deck resurfacing process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the pool deck resurfacing process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pool deck resurfacing project depends on the size and complexity of your deck, as well as the chosen materials. A typical residential project might take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including preparation, application, and curing times. Weather conditions in Las Vegas, particularly extreme heat, can also influence the timeline. We'll provide a specific project schedule during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most projects take 3-7 days, depending on deck size, complexity, materials, and weather. A specific schedule is provided after consultation.
